input: Set up a micro-investing account with spare change

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Spare Change Micro-Investing Account
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to open and configure a micro-investing account that automatically invests spare change from everyday purchases.

questions.title: Which micro-investing app are you considering using?
questions.description: Identify the specific platform the user has in mind, such as Acorns, Stash, Robinhood, or another service.

questions.title: Do you already have a bank account to link?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing checking or debit account ready to connect for round-up transactions.

questions.title: What is your primary goal for this investment account?
questions.description: Clarify the user's financial objective, such as building an emergency fund, saving for a purchase, or long-term wealth growth.

questions.title: What is your comfort level with investment risk?
questions.description: Understand whether the user prefers conservative, moderate, or aggressive portfolio options when setting up the account.

questions.title: Do you want to add recurring deposits beyond spare change?
questions.description: Find out if the user also wants to schedule fixed weekly or monthly contributions on top of round-up investing.

questions.title: What country or region are you located in?
questions.description: Confirm the user's location to ensure the recommended platforms and account types are available to them.

questions.title: Have you ever opened a brokerage or investing account before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's prior experience to tailor the level of guidance and detail needed for each setup step.
